guide.title: Official documentation
guide.desc: The main destination for user guides, development notes and technical tutorials.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.desc: Learn the basics of accounts, instances, and resources, plus the system and version requirements before you start.

pluginPackages.title: .eclplugin package format
pluginPackages.desc: Plugin archives, dependency locks, offline wheels, installation and the actual runtime boundaries.

themePlugin.title: Theme bundles & extension protocol
themePlugin.desc: Learn about .ecltheme bundles, appearance capabilities and the theme plugin protocol.

cli.title: Command line & quick launch
cli.desc: Command-line options, instance launch workflows and script integration.

instances.title: Instances & game management
instances.desc: Keep separate instances for different versions and modpacks, each with its own Java, memory, and launch arguments. Track running instances, worlds, servers, screenshots, and logs, and import .zip / .mcworld saves.

resources.title: Mods, packs & downloads
resources.desc: Install game versions and download Mods, resource packs, shaders, data packs, and modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge — filtered by version and loader, sortable by downloads or follows, with update management.

java.title: Java runtime
java.desc: Scan local Java installations, download and install Temurin runtimes, and let each instance pick the right Java automatically or pin one manually.

users.title: Accounts & wardrobe
users.desc: Microsoft device-code sign-in, offline accounts, and third-party auth. Switch accounts quickly and keep a local skin and cape wardrobe with 3D preview, PNG import/export, and skin upload.

schematic.title: 3D schematic preview
schematic.desc: Open schematic files inside the launcher, rotate and zoom the whole structure, and slice by Y layer to inspect the details.

plugin.title: Plugin extensibility
plugin.desc: Install .eclplugin packages to extend authentication, crash analysis, and UI slots; source confirmation and dependency checks are built in.

palette.title: Four built-in themes
palette.desc: Classic, Folia, Absolutely, and four Catppuccin flavors — with light/dark mode, accent colors, image or video backgrounds, transparency, blur, fonts, and corner radius.

crash.title: Crash analysis
crash.desc: Collects game exit information and crash logs, then analyzes likely causes with rule and mod data to help you find the problem.

tools.title: Toolbox
tools.desc: Custom file downloads plus Minecraft skin avatar cropping and PNG export — all in one place.

updates.title: Update checks
updates.desc: Check for launcher updates from Settings → About. Packaged builds with built-in updates can download and, after confirmation, restart the app.

i18n.title: Six interface languages
i18n.desc: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, German, and Russian — manage accounts, games, and settings in the language you know best.
